description: Make your reports highly functional with a set of visual slicers designed as interactive tabs Dividers is a sleek and intuitive way to display and filter category data in your Power BI reports. Acting as unobtrusive "page furniture," Dividers presents categories as a set of tabs. The color and order of each tab can be data-driven, helping users to use the visual with no training. Why choose Viz Data for Power BI? We design beautiful and highly functional custom visuals that seamlessly blend into your Power BI reports while maintaining the polish of PowerPoint and modern web design. We strive to make our visuals easier to use than even standard visuals. Key Features and Benefits ⚡ Clear and Intuitive Filtering: Display categories as adjacent tabs, offering a structured and space-saving way to highlight or filter the other visuals on your page. ⚡ Flexible Layout: Choose between horizontal and vertical tab arrangements and align the tabs left, right, top or bottom so you can use your report space efficiently. ⚡ Advanced Styling Options: Customize tab widths, colors, and layout with heatmap coloring, gradients, or solid colors. ⚡ Interactive Filtering: Click or Ctrl+Click to filter or highlight other visuals—no need for additional slicers. ⚡ Data-Driven Sorting: Sort tabs alphabetically, numerically, or by a custom data series. ⚡ Data-Driven…
